hypothesis: Observed-only revalidation under the unchanged exp-20260715-006 attribution policy: on the matured post-2026-06-30 exit-lifecycle cohort (281 settled rows, 40 advisory, 22 hard-stop versus the 141/20/14 cohort judged by exp-20260722-001), high-urgency and hard-stop advisory positions should show persistently worse next-open-to-five-session-close returns than no-advisory positions with negative severity monotonicity, broad date support, and single-name adverse-PnL concentration at or below 50%; no threshold, bucket, horizon, source, or response function changes.

provenance.baseline_policy: carry every held position unchanged from the next open through the five-session close regardless of advisory state
provenance.price_clock: advisory state frozen at the daily shadow-log observation, settled at next-open entry and five-session close

expectation_gap.gap_definition: The carry-unchanged prior treats every held position as equally worth holding through the next five sessions, while the independently produced exit-lifecycle severity state claims high-urgency and hard-stop positions are in adverse path states that persist into settlement.

transmission.catalyst: A production trailing-stop/target lifecycle advisory (high_urgency or hard_stop) recorded before the next-open settlement clock.
transmission.expected_direction: Advisory positions should settle with worse H5 returns than no-advisory positions if path deterioration persists beyond the advisory date.
transmission.half_life: From the advisory observation date's next open through the fifth following session close.

why_not_arbitraged: The claim concerns only already-held internal positions and their own forward carry; it is not a public entry signal. Any persistent separation would monetize only as freed slot capital via an exit policy, which itself requires slot-reuse/winner-collateral accounting that does not exist yet; four prior fixed-family probes failed to confirm persistence, most recently on adverse-PnL concentration.
falsifier: Reject unless on the frozen cohort: settled rows >= 100, advisory rows >= 20, hard-stop rows >= 8; high-urgency AND hard-stop mean AND median H5 returns below no-advisory; negative severity Spearman monotonicity on return and SPY-replacement value; at least three comparable dates with advisory worse; and max single-name adverse-PnL share <= 50%. Even a full pass remains observed-only and promotes no exit policy.

baseline.policy: Carry each settled held position unchanged from next open through the five-session close; the no-advisory bucket provides the comparison carry.
baseline.universe: All post-2026-06-30 observed, H5-closed exit-lifecycle rows in the frozen 20260805 outcome ledger.

treatment.policy: Attribute the identical carry by the recorded advisory_bucket (none / high_urgency / hard_stop) from exit_lifecycle_shadow_log_v1; buckets, thresholds, and horizon are exactly the exp-20260715-006 policy with no retune.

replacement_value_comparator: The no-advisory bucket of the same cohort under identical next-open/H5-close settlement, plus SPY same-window replacement value per row.

execution_envelope.borrow_dependency: None; attribution over already-settled rows only.
execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: No capital is allocated; the probe reads settled ledger rows and cannot exceed them.
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Gross diagnostic returns as settled in the outcome ledger; no new cost assumptions are introduced.
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: None; no instrument is traded, mapped, or sized.
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Settlement prices already exist in the ledger from the canonical warehouse; no new liquidity assumption.
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: Advisory state precedes settlement by construction (observed_date before h5 entry open); the ledger fail-closes on stale bars since exp-20260805-004.
